title: Venture Mechanics - 6 Founder Survival Simulators
description: Explore six interactive founder simulators: liquidation waterfalls, entity choice, down-round ratchets, board control, SAFE dilution, and vesting decisions.

maker.name: 4weird Games
maker.bio: Interactive browser simulators demystifying venture capital and startup governance, directly adapted from Ron Wiener's book and Venture Mechanics.

credits.name: Ron Wiener
credits.role: Author of 'Lawyers, Venture Capitalists and Other Useful Predators'

keyboard.Mouse / Touch: Switch sub-games, toggle terms, adjust sliders, and run interactive scenarios

instructions: Choose one of six simulators from the top menu. Adjust assumptions to compare founder outcomes, then try the waterfall challenges. All tax and governance examples are simplified educational models.
